A food item which restores {{Energy||15 -}} {{Energy||25}} and applies the slow metabolism buff when consumed. It must be made in the [[oven]] and higher quality versions of the dish have a larger restorative effect. For the main page on preparing food see [[cooking]].

==Effect==

On use, a creamy vegetable soup will apply the slow metabolism buff for a duration of 2 minutes, extending the duration of all other buffs. For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
